description: RAE supplies smart-meter and submeter measurements from two residential houses for evaluating energy-analysis algorithms. Simon Fraser University and Rainforest Automation publish one-hertz mains and appliance data together with thermostat environmental observations. The Harvard Dataverse repository lists tab-separated tables, CSV archives, labels and house documentation, all publicly available under CC BY 4.0 with a required article citation. This site-specific release can calibrate residential demand profiles, load-disaggregation methods and heat-pump operation assumptions. Its small household sample does not establish representative regional consumption, and thermostat and submeter coverage differ between houses. The repository metadata describes an initial 2017 release; detailed recording intervals should be checked in each house file. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
